exposure: Low morphological quality human preimplantation embryos
outcome: Migration capacity of human endometrial stromal cells (hESCs)
cohort: The study utilized human endometrial stromal cells (hESCs) obtained from endometrial biopsies of women with cesarean section scars, and embryo conditioned medium from individually cultured human preimplantation embryos (high and low morphological quality) derived from routine ICSI procedures.
finding: High-quality human preimplantation embryos secrete hsa-miR-320a, which alone can stimulate the migration of decidualized human endometrial stromal cells by altering the expression of genes involved in cell adhesion and cytoskeleton organization.
